title: tx_queue_empty _Nonnull annotation contradicts documented NULL handling
description:
Parameter marked _Nonnull but doc says 'NULL returns true'. Implementation confirms NULL is handled (returns true). Annotation should be _Nullable; current state misleads static analyzers and callers about the contract.

File: lichen/subsys/lichen/link/include/lichen/tx_queue.h
Line: 202
close_reason: Fixed this session (working tree, uncommitted). Chose 'accept NULL + _Nullable' over 'reject NULL' because: (1) impl deliberately handles NULL returning true, doc documents it; (2) codebase pattern favors _Nullable for NULL-tolerant APIs — tx_queue_count in the same diff was already converted to _Nullable; (3) annotation-only change, no API behavior change for callers relying on empty(NULL)==true. Changes: lichen/subsys/lichen/link/include/lichen/tx_queue.h line 209 _Nonnull->_Nullable plus @param doc updated to '(NULL accepted, returns true)'; new regression test test_empty_null_returns_true in lichen/tests/tx_queue/main.c asserting the documented contract. Verified: host cmake build 22/22 pass incl. new test; clang probe with -Wnonnull confirms tx_queue_empty(NULL) no longer warns while tx_queue_init(NULL) still does (_Nonnull correctly retained there).
